# JavaScript

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from javascript/lang.json and javascript/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//javascript:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//javascript:defs.bzl", "javascript_library", "javascript_wasm_bindgen_library", "javascript_binary")
```

## Rules

### `javascript_library`

```python
javascript_library(name, srcs, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over js_library.

### `javascript_wasm_bindgen_library`

```python
javascript_wasm_bindgen_library(name, bindgen, deps = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Adapts one browser rust_binary to JsInfo without rerunning bindgen.

### `javascript_binary`

```python
javascript_binary(name, *, srcs = None, main = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over js_binary. main is the entry file; srcs are added to data.

### `javascript_test`

```python
javascript_test(name, *, srcs = None, main = None, runner = "jest", node_modules = None, data = None, package_json = None, visibility = None, env_inherit = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over jest_test, or js_test with runner = "node". runner defaults to "jest"; main is linted unless it is an external label.

### `javascript_bench`

```python
javascript_bench(name, *, srcs, main = None, node_modules, data = None, args = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A javascript_test run by dx bench. `main`, the first of srcs by default, exports a tinybench Bench as its default export; its results land in dx-bench.json. `node_modules` must link tinybench.

### `javascript_fuzz_test`

```python
javascript_fuzz_test(name, *, srcs, main = None, node_modules, data = None, visibility = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A Jazzer.js fuzz target plus a `<name>_run` runner for `dx fuzz`. `main`, the first of srcs by default, exports `fuzz(data)`. `node_modules` must link @jazzer.js/core.

### `javascript_web_app`

```python
javascript_web_app(name, html, bindgen, assets = None, threads = False, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Stages one relocatable browser directory from HTML, bindgen, and assets.

### `javascript_web_bundle`

```python
javascript_web_bundle(name, app, bundler, config = None, entry = None, bundler_args = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Bundles one staged application through a declared bundler executable.

## API docs

Tool: `typedoc`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/javascript:defs.bzl", "javascript_doc_shard")
```

### `javascript_doc_shard`

```python
javascript_doc_shard(name, srcs, tsconfig, entry_points, package, deps = [], options = [], **kwargs)
```

Declares a TypeDoc JSON run over one JavaScript project (tsconfig sets allowJs) and its DocIr shard.

Build the docs with `tools/dx docs`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

## Dependencies

Add the package to the root `package.json`, then run `dx generate --apply`. dx
writes a missing `pnpm-lock.yaml`. An import of a package listed
in the root `package.json` resolves to `//:node_modules/<package>`.

## Quality

`biome` formats and lints JavaScript. Its config is `biome.json` at the
workspace root. JavaScript has no typecheck tool. To lint with `eslint`, put
`eslint.config.mjs` at the root and bind it with `eslint_config`.

```sh
dx format --apply
dx lint
```

## Bench and fuzz

`javascript_bench` runs a tinybench `Bench` for `dx bench`, and `javascript_fuzz_test` runs a Jazzer.js target for `dx fuzz`. List `tinybench` or `@jazzer.js/core` in `package.json` and pass `node_modules`. See [`dx bench`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/bench.md) and [`dx fuzz`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/fuzz.md).
